findings.failure_scenario: SPEC text (mirrored in the M1.21 backlog row and the test file's own comment) cites ADR-0014 for 'the wire format's u8 lane field', but ADR-0014 itself specifies a signed i8 lane (range -2..+2, which u8 cannot represent). Pre-existing elsewhere (roadmap.md, ADR-0015), propagated rather than introduced here, but newly cited against the one document that contradicts it -- a reader tracing the citation finds ADR-0014 disagrees.
